semantics.load: When load is high at a rising edge, q becomes sampled data; load takes priority over evolution. Consecutive high cycles each load data.
semantics.evolution: When load is low at a rising edge, all 512 cells simultaneously update from pre-edge q. Left of i is q[i+1]; right is q[i-1].
semantics.boundaries: q[-1] and q[512] are constant zero; no wraparound.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: Initial state is unspecified; tests load before checking evolution.
semantics.between_edges: q holds between positive clock edges; changes of load or data alone do not update q.

numeric.state: 512 packed one-bit cells, bit i denotes cell i
numeric.operations: Boolean Rule 110 lookup, no arithmetic, rounding, saturation or overflow
numeric.latency: one update or load per positive edge; no extra pipeline

verification.oracle: Independent per-cell case lookup directly from the original eight-entry table, using pre-edge reference state and constant-zero boundaries.
directed: all eight neighborhoods at an interior cell
successive load edges and load priority
verification.random: Deterministic pseudo-random 512-bit loads interleaved with multi-cycle evolution; compare all 512 outputs after each rising edge.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp; finite compile and simulation timeouts; internal testbench watchdog.
